{{small|5 games}} |prevseason=[[2017–18 Superliga Argentina|2017–18]] |nextseason=[[2019–20 Superliga Argentina|2019–20]] }} The '''2018–19 Superliga Argentina''' (officially the '''Superliga Quilmes Clásica''' for sponsorship reasons){{cite web|url=http://www.ambito.com/899624-quilmes-es-el-nuevo-sponsor-principal-de-la-superliga |title=Quilmes es el nuevo sponsor principal de la Superliga |date=6 October 2017 |publisher=Ámbito |language=Spanish}} was the 129{{small|th}} season of top-flight professional [[football in Argentina]]. The season began on 10 August 2018 and ended on 7 April 2019.{{cite web|url=http://www.afa.com.ar/upload/reglamento/Superliga%202018-2019%20-%20Reglamento.PDF |title=REGLAMENTO DE COMPETENCIAS PRIMERA DIVISIÓN – 2018/2019 |publisher=AFA |language=Spanish}} [[Boca Juniors]] were the defending champions. Twenty-six teams competed in the league, twenty-four returning from the [[2017–18 Superliga Argentina|2017–18]] season and two promoted from the [[2017–18 Primera B Nacional]] ([[Aldosivi]] and [[San Martín de Tucumán|San Martín (T)]]). Four teams ([[Club Atlético Temperley|Temperley]], [[Club Olimpo|Olimpo]], [[Arsenal de Sarandí|Arsenal]], and [[Chacarita Juniors]]) were relegated to the Primera B Nacional championship in the previous tournament. [[Racing Club de Avellaneda|Racing]] won their eighteenth national league championship with one match to spare after a 1–1 draw against Tigre on 31 March 2019.{{cite web |url=https://www.saf.com.ar/institucional/noticia/racing-es-campeon |title=¡Racing es campeón! |date=31 March 2019 |publisher=SAF |language=Spanish |access-date=1 April 2019 |archive-date=1 April 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190401042734/https://www.saf.com.ar/institucional/noticia/racing-es-campeon |url-status=dead }}{{cite web |url=http://www.afa.com.ar/11876/racing-se-consagro-campeon |title=Racing se consagró campeón |date=31 March 2019 |publisher=AFA |language=Spanish |access-date=1 April 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190401023203/http://www.afa.com.ar/11876/racing-se-consagro-campeon |archive-date=1 April 2019 |url-status=dead }} ==Competition format== The tournament was contested by 26 teams. It began on 10 August 2018 and ended on 7 April 2019. Each team played the other 25 teams in a single [[round-robin tournament]]. The additional match against the [[Football rivalries in Argentina|main rival team]] in the so-called "Fecha de Clásicos" was once again omitted in this season. From 14 April to 2 June 2019, the Primera División played a new competition named "[[Copa de la Superliga]]".{{cite web|url=https://www.tycsports.com/nota/superliga/2018/06/18/superliga-formato-comienzo-ascensos-descensos-y-una-yapa-.html |title=Superliga: Formato, comienzo, ascensos, descensos y una yapa |date=18 June 2018 |publisher=TyC Sports |language=Spanish}} ==Club information== ===Stadia and locations=== {{location map+ |Argentina |float=right |width=300 |caption=Locations of the 2018–19 Argentine Primera División teams outside [[Greater Buenos Aires]]. |places= {{location map~ |Argentina |lat=-34.603611 |long=-58.381667 |label=
